site.name: Kindly
site.tagline: Your members' conversations, organized and in each delegate's own name.

home.title: Your members' conversations, organized and in your own name
home.subtitle: Kindly gathers in one inbox the conversations each delegate holds from their own WhatsApp, links them to each member's profile and puts the regulations in front of you, with their source and validity.

one.title: Each delegate, with their own number
one.body: Kindly syncs each professional's WhatsApp account. It does not replace it nor centralize it on an organization number.

two.title: The member's profile, next to the chat
two.body: Affiliation and fee, reference delegate, open tasks and the contact's other conversations, in view while you reply.

three.title: Regulations with source and validity
three.body: A knowledge base where each text states its document, version and validity dates, and procedures with the documents to ask for.

one.a: For unions, associations and firms whose delegates serve their members over messaging.

two.q: Does an AI reply for me?
two.a: No. Nothing is sent to a contact unless a person writes or accepts it. Kindly does not give advice: it shows the loaded regulations, with their source and validity, for you to review.

three.a: Each organization only sees its own: the database enforces that isolation. The detail, with the providers involved, is in the privacy policy. Kindly does not keep your members' files.
